notes.title: All of the BROTHERHOOD games, including STASIS are on Discount! + NEW GAME!
notes.content:
All of the BROTHERHOOD games, including BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION, STASIS and CAYNE (Deluxe) are on SPECIAL Discount! 

This is to celebrate the launch of BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION in Polish, Chinese and Bulgarian! 

Also, be sure to WISHLIST BONE TOTEM - The new STASIS game coming next year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/20d2ee801c4315a5f146fdfe3da0816d770be751.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/912570/BEAUTIFUL_DESOLATION/

We are pleased to announce that award-winning BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION is
now available in [u][b]Polish[/b][/u]!

Bulgarian, and both Simplified and Traditional Chinese, have also
recently been added to the localization offerings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/0afb5ea26660b03b8312c9b37b5c23efd9e0308a.jpg[/img]

[h1]BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION will be discounted 35% until August 10. STASIS and
all the deluxe content/soundtrack is up at discount too![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33620429/c86382faf797bc0ae3ceff787eaac58042d68e18.jpg[/img]

BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION is a 2D isometric adventure game set in the distant
future. Explore a post-apocalyptic landscape, solve puzzles, meet new
friends and make powerful enemies, mediate conflicts and fight for your
life as you unravel the secrets of the world around you in this homage
to adventure games from your childhood.

[b]Be sure to WISHLIST our next game, STASIS 2: BONE TOTEM which is has a
2022 release date.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426010/STASIS_BONE_TOTEM/

PS

You can visit Discord and chat with the developers here:
[url=DISCORD INVITE]https://www.thebrotherhoodgames.com/studio/discord[/url]
